name: GWS Toolkit
description: Security-hardened Google Workspace integration with per-agent credential routing, delegated Google API transport, and policy-controlled writes.

enabledServices.label: Enabled Services
enabledServices.help: Workspace service families available to the toolkit.

enabledWriteServices.label: Enabled Write Services
enabledWriteServices.help: Write-capable service families. Empty means read-only.

binaryPath.label: gws Binary Path
binaryPath.help: Optional explicit path to gws binary. If omitted, PATH lookup is used.

approvedCredentialDirs.label: Approved Credential Dirs
approvedCredentialDirs.help: Credentials file path must remain inside one of these directories.

credentialsFile.label: Legacy Credentials File
credentialsFile.help: Phase 1 compatibility credential path reference only; prefer explicit credentials_file routes.

tokenEnvVar.label: Token Environment Variable
tokenEnvVar.help: Environment variable name for pre-obtained access token (break-glass only).

allowWriteOperations.label: Allow Write Operations
allowWriteOperations.help: Global write gate. Writes remain denied unless this is true.

allowUnboundAgents.label: Allow Unbound Agents
allowUnboundAgents.help: Allow default route fallback when an agent/sub-agent has no explicit binding.

defaultCredentialRoute.label: Default Credential Route
defaultCredentialRoute.help: Optional fallback route used only when allowUnboundAgents is true.

defaultScopesProfile.label: Scopes Profile
defaultScopesProfile.help: minimal for read-only defaults, service-set for enabled service scopes, or custom.

customScopes.label: Custom Scopes
customScopes.help: Optional scopes when defaultScopesProfile is custom.

credentialRoutes.label: Credential Routes
credentialRoutes.help: Named identity routes for agents and sub-agents.

agentCredentialBindings.label: Agent Credential Bindings
agentCredentialBindings.help: Bind subjects like agent:ops or subagent:research to named routes.

workspaceIdentityDomains.label: Workspace Identity Domains
workspaceIdentityDomains.help: Optional allowed Google Workspace email domains for delegated agent identities.

requireHumanApprovalFor.label: Approval Hints
requireHumanApprovalFor.help: Optional action labels to highlight as human-approval sensitive in diagnostics.
